description: This file contains utility functions and logic for building a structured Logical Node (LN) tree from parsed SCL data, validation results, or fallback mock data. It includes functions for parsing references, extracting payloads, and constructing hierarchical tree structures for UI rendering in an IEC 61850 context.

methods.name: safeArray
methods.description: Ensures the input is an array; returns empty array if not.

methods.name: stringifyMaybe
methods.description: Converts a value to string, JSON stringifies if possible, or returns empty string for null/undefined.

methods.name: uniqKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key string by joining parts with '|', filtering out falsy values.

methods.name: titleFromKind
methods.description: Returns a human-readable title for a node kind.

methods.name: parseRef
methods.description: Heuristically parses IEC 61850 reference strings into partial segments: IED, LD, LN.

methods.name: getParsedPayload
methods.description: Extracts the relevant parsed SCL or model payload from validation result.

methods.name: getValidationDetails
methods.description: Extracts validation issue details from validation result.

methods.name: buildFromParsedScl
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical tree from a parsed SCL model if shape is recognized.

methods.name: buildFromValidationDetails
methods.description: Builds a tree grouping issues by IED, LD, LN based on validation details.

methods.name: buildMockTree
methods.description: Provides a fallback mock tree structure with preset nodes and issues.
